headline: Samira reaches the real sign-in surface after seeing prompt-to-plan, timeline, prioritization, reflection, collaboration, and MCP access as one adaptable system.
overview: A live product-level walk for Plan Quest, framed around Samira Nasser's actual decision rather than a list of routes.
payoff: Samira reaches the real sign-in surface after seeing prompt-to-plan, timeline, prioritization, reflection, collaboration, and MCP access as one adaptable system.

scenes.title: The job is a plan that survives change
scenes.narrative: The promise names the failure mode Samira recognizes: goals keep changing shape after the first burst of motivation.
frameCaptions: The job is a plan that survives change

scenes.title: Three real planning problems anchor the tour
scenes.narrative: Broad goals, changing plans, and lost momentum are presented as separate situations rather than one generic productivity pitch.
frameCaptions: Three real planning problems anchor the tour

scenes.title: Changing plans is treated as normal
scenes.narrative: The active scenario shifts to rebalancing as dates, capacity, and energy change—the core behavior of a living plan.
frameCaptions: Changing plans is treated as normal

scenes.title: The system spans creation through reflection
scenes.narrative: Prompt planning, timeline, priorities, progress, notes, reflection, teamwork, and bring-your-own AI are visible as one connected workflow.
frameCaptions: The system spans creation through reflection
scenes.action: Moved to the complete feature set.

scenes.title: The next step is the real product gate
scenes.narrative: The authenticated workspace offers Google, GitHub, email, and Twitter sign-in. No account is created during this evidence run.
frameCaptions: The next step is the real product gate
